title: [Spec Decode] Add bounded attention with full KV retention for EAGLE3 drafts
body_opening:
## Purpose

Allow EAGLE3 draft models to bound attention compute without evicting older draft KV blocks.

A normal sliding-window cache uses `SlidingWindowSpec`, which recycles blocks outside the window. This PR adds an opt-in `draft_attention_window` field for `method="eagle3"`. The draft attention backend applies the configured window, while KV planning uses `FullAttentionSpec` and retains the complete draft cache. The target model and the default draft behavior are unchanged.

## Purpose

Follow-up to #57435. That PR moved the inverse RoPE into the sparse-decode
reduce epilogue, but the reduce still writes the attention output as bf16
`[T, H, 512]` and `wo_a` then reads it back through a bf16 hipBLASLt einsum
(`Cijk_Alik_Bljk_BBS_BH_Bias...`) on a dequantized bf16 copy of the weight.
`wo_a` is weight-bandwidth bound at decode, so it pays for twice the bytes
the checkpoint actually stores.

epilogue also emits `wo_a`'s MXFP8 input directly, and `wo_a` runs as a
